Write a plan only. Do not answer the question. Do not write ANSWER.

RECOMMENDER says: Have you seen The Blind Side  (2009)  with Sandra Bullock?
SEEKER says: No I have not....That's the one about her adopting the black kid right?
RECOMMENDER says: Yeah, it's really good....What about The Help  (2011)  with Emma Stone and Viola Davis?
SEEKER says: I'll rent it tonight....I did see that. It made me cry and laugh throughout.
RECOMMENDER says: Yes, definitely. Loved that one. I also really like Precious   about the girl whose mother is real mean to her.

SEEKER says: Yeah that's the one. I've read the book and loved it but I've never seen the movie.
RECOMMENDER says: It's very sad, but very good.
SEEKER says: I can only imagine. I cried through the entire book
RECOMMENDER says: I'll have to read the book now. How about a classic now... Breakfast at Tiffany's  (1961) ?
